name: Code Conductor coding-agent smoke benchmark
description: Small, deterministic tasks used to compare provider success rate, verification quality, latency, and retry behavior. Each task is run in a fresh copy of its fixture.

tasks.prompt: Implement calculate_discount(price, percent) in discount.py. Return price after applying the percentage discount. Validate that price is non-negative and percent is between 0 and 100 inclusive; raise ValueError otherwise. Keep the API simple and make the existing pytest suite pass.

Implement merge_intervals(intervals) in merge_intervals.py. Return a new list sorted by start, merging all overlapping or touching intervals (so [1,3] and [3,5] become [1,5]). Handle empty input and negative values. Keep the function API simple and make the existing pytest suite pass.

Implement slugify(value) in slugify.js. Convert input to a string, lowercase it, replace every run of non-ASCII letters/digits with one hyphen, and remove leading/trailing hyphens. Preserve digits. Punctuation-only input should return an empty string. Do not change the tests; make the existing Node test suite pass.
